resources.string: A clearer view of your storage
Find photos and videos larger than 20 MB. Review every item before asking Android to delete it.
Media access is needed to scan photos and videos.
Nothing is deleted automatically. Review the list first.
Deletion was cancelled or not approved.
System-confirmed batch deletion requires Android 11 or newer.

Limits: this app cannot access other apps’ private data or protected Android/data folders, and cannot guarantee removal of every uninstall leftover. The selected-folder scanner only inspects locations you grant through Android’s folder picker. Nothing is deleted automatically.

Choose a folder you own (for example Downloads). The app checks only that selected folder for temporary-looking files and empty folders. It cannot enter protected Android/data or other apps’ private folders.
These are suggestions, not guaranteed junk. Select only items you recognize and want to remove.
Found %1$d possible items in the chosen folder.
Could not scan this folder. Check the folder permission and try again.
Select only the media files you want to delete. Android will ask for confirmation.
Select at least one item first.

Android does not let an ordinary, non-root app silently clear every app cache. Open Android’s storage manager to review system-provided cleanup options. This button does not promise that caches will be cleared.
